'''Creeska''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] competitor who attended the [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]]. In the tournament, he was cheating with a [[Skifter/Legends|skifter]].
